bodyHtml:
Education

  • Master of Public Policy (MPP), University of Chicago, USA
  • B.A. in Political Science (Public Administration Division), National Taiwan University, Taiwan

Professional Experience

  • Associate Professor, Graduate Institute of Journalism, National Taiwan University (2025–present)
  • Deputy General Manager, TVBS News Department (2020–2025)
  • Producer and Host, Step by Step: Discovering New Taiwan, TVBS (2004–2025)
  • Director, TVBS News Department (2007–2020)
  • Staff Reporter, News Anchor, Head of Political Desk, Head of Special Reports Desk, Deputy Director of News Gathering Center, Deputy Managing Editor & Producer, TVBS (1993–2007)
  • Adjunct Lecturer, Department of Journalism, Shih Hsin University (2005–2006)
  • Political Reporter, United Evening News (1992–1993)
  • Political Reporter, Independence Evening Post (1991–1992)
  • International News Editor/Translator, China Times (1988–1989)

Honors and Awards

  • Eisenhower Fellow, Eisenhower Fellowships, USA (2016)
  • Distinguished Award for Excellence in Communication Management, Chinese Communication Management Association, Taiwan (2015)
  • Award for Outstanding Contribution to Communication, Hsing Yun Truth, Goodness and Beauty Journalism Awards (2010)
  • Golden Wheel Award for Best Program Host, Rotary International Public Service Journalism Awards (2010)
  • Golden Bell Award, Educational and Informational Program Category, Step by Step: Discovering New Taiwan (2009)
  • Golden Bell Award, Best Host in Educational and Informational Programming, Step by Step: Discovering New Taiwan (2005)
  • Golden Bell Award, Best News Reporting, River of Love (Dahe Lian) Investigative Series (2000)
expertise: Television News Reporting; Government and Public Affairs Reporting; Current Affairs Forum: Planning and Production
name: I-I Chan
title: Associate Professor
